(function(){
var root=document.getElementById('ck-free-week'); if(!root) return;
var M={fail:'Something went wrong. Please try again.',sent:'Check your email for the code and how to enter it.',already:'This email is already signed up. Look for our email with the code, and check your spam folder if it isn\u2019t there.'};
var f=root.querySelector('form'),msg=root.querySelector('.ckfw-msg'),btn=root.querySelector('.ckfw-key');
f.addEventListener('submit',function(e){
  e.preventDefault(); var em=f.email.value.trim();
  if(!f.email.checkValidity()){f.email.reportValidity();return;}
  btn.disabled=true; msg.textContent='';
  fetch('/wp-json/ck/v1/waitlist',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},credentials:'omit',body:JSON.stringify({list:'hot-mess-free-week',email:em,website:f.website.value})})
  .then(function(r){return r.json();})
  .then(function(j){
    if(j&&j.ok){msg.textContent=j.already?M.already:M.sent;f.classList.add('done');}
    else{msg.textContent=M.fail;btn.disabled=false;}
  }).catch(function(){msg.textContent=M.fail;btn.disabled=false;});
});
/* the film: the Hot Mess page's buy-section film, its size and codec picked as on that page; reduced motion keeps the first frame */

if(v&&!window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches){

  v.muted=true; v.src='https://clayburton.github.io/strange-demos/films/hot-mess-dual-'+sz+'.'+k+'.mp4';
  var pl=v.play(); if(pl&&pl.catch) pl.catch(function(){});
}
})();
